answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in tide, expire in gale, and hollow lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 39 aliases as a result needs 107 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 20 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
